{{Quote|Gather as many Knights as you can without raising alarm|Vernestra Rwoh, to Mog Adana|<ref name="TA" />}}
'''Sage Kinzem''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Zinchorian]] who was a member of the [[Jedi Order]], ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] around [[132 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year|year]], soon after making Knight, they were one of the [[Jedi]] sent to the [[planet]] [[Brendok]]. [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]], who led the group, took them to a [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] on the planet. In the [[Rite of Ascension|fortress' courtyard]], the team discovered the [[Death|dead]] body of Jedi Master [[Sol]], after which Rwoh sent the other Jedi, including Kinzem, to search the nearby area.

==History==
{{Quote|Set up a five-klick perimeter. They couldn't have gone far.|Vernestra Rwoh, to Jedi including Sage Kinzem|<ref name="TA" />}}
Sage Kinzem was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Zinchorian]] who served the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Around [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date"> [[Star Wars: The Acolyte|''The Acolyte'']] takes place in [[132 BBY]]. As ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes Sage Kinzem completed their [[Jedi Trials]] shortly before the events of ''The Acolyte'',  the Trials and subsequent promotion must have happened around 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> Kinzem passed their [[Jedi Trials]] and ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Later, in that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the Zinchorian was conversing with<ref name="TC">{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}}</ref> the [[Dokora]] [[Jedi]] [[Cantu Fallum]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and a [[human]] in a hallway of a [[spaceport]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="TC" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]]. During the group's conversation, the [[Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Vernestra Rwoh]] walked past them on her way to depart to the planet [[Khofar]] with a team assembled by the [[human]]<ref name="TC" /> [[Padawan]] [[Mog Adana]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> to investigate a distress signal sent by the Jedi Master [[Sol]] after his team [[Mission to Khofar|died]].<ref name="TC" />

[[File:VernestraJediTeamBrendok-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|320px|right|Kinzem and their fellow Jedi in the fortress' courtyard]]
Soon after, Sol was discovered to be on the planet Brendok. When Adana informed Rwoh of Sol's location,<ref name="TA" /> she instructed him<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> to assemble as big a group of Jedi as possible without raising alarm. Kinzem was one of the Jedi chosen by Adana. Having travelled to the planet aboard the [[starship]]<ref name="TA" /> ''[[Cantaros]]''<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> along with the rest of the Jedi, Kinzem disembarked from the ship upon arrival to Brendok. They followed Rwoh to an abandoned [[Brendok fortress|fortress]], where the Mirialan Jedi Master opened the entrance using [[the Force]]. The Jedi, including Kinzem, entered the fortress and made their way into its [[Rite of Ascension courtyard|courtyard]], where the group noticed the [[Death|dead]] body of Sol, killed earlier by his former [[Padawan]] [[Verosha Aniseya|Osha Aniseya]].<ref name="TA" />

While Kinzem was looking around the courtyard, Rwoh ordered two Jedi to search the premises. As they shifted their focus on the Jedi Master, she ordered the rest of the group—including Kinzem—to set up a five-[[kilometer]] perimeter to find the other individuals present. The Jedi split up into three groups, with Kinzem turning around to return to the fortress using the entrance through which they got into the courtyard. The groups reunited in the [[forest]] outside of the fortress, where Fallum handed Aniseya's satchel to the [[Tynnan]] [[tracker]] [[Bazil]], who then led the group towards Aniseya. At some point on their way towards Aniseya, Bazil and the Jedi broke into a run until they reached a [[bunta tree]], finding only Aniseya's [[twin]] [[Gender|sister]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae Aniseya]], whose memory had been [[Memory rub|erased]]. Afterward, during a tribunal with [[senator]]s from the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]], Rwoh reported that Sol's corpse was found in the fortress to answer a question regarding the Jedi Master's fate, speculating he took his own life.<ref name="TA" />

==Personality and traits==
Sage Kinzem had [[Color|light]] skin on their face, with their skin on their neck and rest of their head having a gray-blue coloration typical for members of their [[species]] when outside of their [[Homeworld|native]] [[methane]] [[atmosphere]]. They sported dark blue facial tattoos and their hair was dark brown<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> with some strands of a gray-blue color similar to their skin. Kinzem wore their hair in a braid that forked at the end.<ref name="TA" /> The Zinchorian had brown [[eye]]s and their horns were black.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Force-sensitive, Kinzem was able to wield the Force. Mog Adana regarded Kinzem to be a competent investigator, placing them on his list of effective Jedi investigators.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While in the spaceport,<ref name="TC" /> and on the mission to Brendok,<ref name="TA" /> Kinzem wore golden and light-yellow [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] with a light-brown undertunic<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and brown pants. They also donned a brown [[cloak]], and tall [[boot]]s. The Jedi Knight also kept a [[lightsaber]] on their brown belt,<ref name="TA" /> which featured the [[Jedi crest|Jedi Order's insignia]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sage Kinzem first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Teach / Corrupt]],"<ref name="TC" /> the sixth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: The Acolyte|''The Acolyte'']], which released on [[July 2]], [[2024]],<ref name="EPG">{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-6-teach-corrupt-episode-guide|text="Teach / Corrupt" - Episode Guide | The Acolyte}}</ref> The individual was later identified as Sage Kinzem in ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in [[2025]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
